name: B47ANCE'd UI

features.text: Public Lua client API 1: styled native controls, renderer, layout, dialogs, focus and bounded tooltips.
Near-black shared surfaces, grey default accent and instance-rounded corners; explicit Small/Normal/Large button helpers preserve existing geometry and native callbacks.
In-game hex/RGB accent editor with live scoped preview, per-consumer/local-player persistence, opacity-only migration and reset to grey.
Consumer/player scoped local appearance with legacy import, lazy appearance editor and original clipboard drawing.
Full vanilla UI overhaul, main-menu/CCTV and advanced layout editor are not implemented.
Public Workshop MP test item 3822582242 confirmed; deterministic package/provenance and canonical listing. Native/dedicated NOT TESTED.

limits: 0.2.0-dev.2 styling is source only; public item 3822582242 remains historical 0.1.0-dev.1 MP test distribution. Native SP/controller/split-screen/dedicated NOT TESTED; rounded draw performance and texture corners require runtime acceptance. Lua-only presentation, no gameplay ownership.
